Definition: probably to glow, i.e. (figuratively) be desolated
BiblicalUsage: The word means to burn or glow, and Isaiah uses it for wickedness that burns like a fire and for a people burned up by the anger of the LORD. It appears once in this form, in the judgment on a nation that would not turn.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that wickedness is its own fire, and it burns the very people who feed it.
